reason: Adds a model-based approval workflow for DeepSeek Harness permission requests, combining deterministic routing with a separate reviewer model and human escalation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于独立评审模型的工具权限审批流程，并支持规则路由、拒绝熔断和人工升级。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness permission workflow that uses a separate reviewer model with rule-based routing, denial circuit breaking, and human escalation.

capabilities: Intercepts permission approval requests in DeepSeek Harness
Routes requests through allowlists, denylists, human-only rules, and a circuit breaker
Invokes a separate reviewer model to allow, deny, or escalate tool requests
Reads tool arguments from the session log for review
Appends model approval or denial decisions to the session
